items.title: The US is banning foreign robots
items.title_zh: 美国FCC宣布禁止进口外国先进机器人
items.summary: The FCC announced an import ban on 'advanced robotic devices' including humanoid and quadruped robots from foreign countries, specifically targeting China. The ban also covers power inverters.

items.title: US bans new Chinese robots, power inverters in latest tech crackdown
items.title_zh: 美国禁止进口中国新型机器人和电源逆变器，科技战再升级
items.summary: The US government has imposed a new ban on Chinese-made advanced robots and power inverters, expanding the tech crackdown beyond semiconductors into embodied AI hardware.

items.title: Delta Intelligence raises 500M RMB angel++ round for humanoid robot foundation models
items.title_zh: 德塔智能完成近5亿元天使++轮融资，UCLA博士团队打造人形机器人基础模型
items.summary: 德塔智能（Delta Intelligence）由三位UCLA博士创立，完成近5亿元天使++轮融资，这是其成立半年内的第六轮融资。公司构建'大脑+小脑+力位混合'三层架构打造通用人形机器人基础模型HFMs，已与智元、乐聚、宇树等头部厂商建立合作。

items.title: Moonshot AI officially open-sources Kimi K3, a 2.8T-parameter MoE large language model
items.title_zh: 月之暗面Kimi K3正式开源：2.8万亿参数MoE大模型发布
items.summary: Moonshot AI officially open-sourced Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model. LM Studio Bionic has already added support for running the model locally.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang meets US officials as scrutiny grows over China chip access
items.title_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋会见美国财长和商务部长，中国芯片出口审查日益严格
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang met with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to discuss AI policy and chip export controls as Washington tightens restrictions on China's access to advanced semiconductors.

items.title: AI leaders from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta sign statement urging coordinated AI governance
items.title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic等1100名AI研究员联名呼吁加强全球AI治理协调
items.summary: Over 1,100 employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, and other leading AI labs signed a statement to the US government supporting a slowdown of frontier AI development and calling for accelerated global coordinated governance.

items.title: Meta and BlackRock form $14B joint venture for Texas data center campus
items.title_zh: Meta与贝莱德成立140亿美元合资企业，在得州开发数据中心园区
items.summary: Meta and BlackRock formed a joint venture to develop a data center campus in El Paso, Texas, with total costs of approximately $14 billion. BlackRock-managed funds will hold 80% ownership, with Meta holding 20% and signing a 4-year initial lease with up to 20-year renewal options.

items.title: Sam Altman says he's 'ready to decelerate' after first visceral AI security incident
items.title_zh: Sam Altman表示在首次亲身感受AI安全事件后'准备放缓'发展步伐
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman expressed openness to slowing AI development pace, citing 'the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally.' His shift in position comes amid growing industry calls for coordinated AI governance.

items.title: Apple hits $5 trillion market cap for the first time
items.title_zh: 苹果市值首次突破5万亿美元
items.summary: Apple crossed a $5 trillion market capitalization for the first time during intraday trading, becoming only the second publicly traded company ever to cross this threshold.

items.title: Nvidia signs $50B Texas data center lease deal with Hut8
items.title_zh: 英伟达签署价值高达500亿美元的得州数据中心租赁协议
items.summary: Nvidia signed a lease commitment with data center developer Hut8 for a 1GW hyperscale data center in Texas. The initial 15-year lease is valued at $19.6 billion, with total value reaching $50 billion including 30-year renewal options.

items.title: The US is banning foreign robots
items.title_zh: 美国FCC宣布禁止进口外国先进机器人
items.summary: The FCC announced an import ban on 'advanced robotic devices' including humanoid and quadruped robots from foreign countries, specifically targeting China. The ban also covers power inverters.

items.title_zh: OpenAI、Anthropic等1100名AI研究员联名呼吁加强全球AI治理协调
items.summary: Over 1,100 employees from OpenAI, Anthropic, Google, Meta, Mistral, and other leading AI labs signed a statement to the US government supporting a slowdown of frontier AI development and calling for accelerated global coordinated governance.

items.title: Meta and BlackRock form $14B joint venture for Texas data center campus
items.title_zh: Meta与贝莱德成立140亿美元合资企业，在得州开发数据中心园区
items.summary: Meta and BlackRock formed a joint venture to develop a data center campus in El Paso, Texas, with total costs of approximately $14 billion. BlackRock-managed funds will hold 80% ownership, with Meta holding 20% and signing a 4-year initial lease with up to 20-year renewal options.

items.title_zh: Sam Altman表示在首次亲身感受AI安全事件后'准备放缓'发展步伐
items.summary: OpenAI CEO Sam Altman expressed openness to slowing AI development pace, citing 'the first security incident that I have felt very viscerally.' His shift in position comes amid growing industry calls for coordinated AI governance.

items.title: Apple hits $5 trillion market cap for the first time
items.title_zh: 苹果市值首次突破5万亿美元
items.summary: Apple crossed a $5 trillion market capitalization for the first time during intraday trading, becoming only the second publicly traded company ever to cross this threshold.

items.title: Apple launches 'Upgrade' device leasing program in partnership with Klarna
items.title_zh: 苹果联合Klarna推出'Upgrade'设备租赁计划
items.summary: Apple launched Apple Upgrade, a new leasing program for iPhone, Mac, iPad, and Apple Watch backed by Klarna, replacing the iPhone Upgrade Program. The launch comes amid 'RAMageddon' — an industry-wide memory chip shortage driving up hardware costs.

items.title: Fish Audio raises $52M seed to build AI voice models for creators and enterprises
items.title_zh: Fish Audio获5200万美元种子轮融资，为创作者和企业构建AI语音模型
items.summary: Fish Audio raised a $52 million seed round. The startup has more than 8 million users of its open-source and hosted AI voice models and generates $21 million in annual recurring revenue.

items.title: Recursive Superintelligence signs $410M compute deal with Amazon
items.title_zh: Recursive Superintelligence与亚马逊签署4.1亿美元算力协议
items.summary: Recursive Superintelligence signed a $410 million compute deal with Amazon, channeling most of its budget directly into compute for self-improving AI systems rather than traditional headcount and operations.

items.title: Samsung's chip workers are jumping ship to rival SK Hynix
items.title_zh: 三星芯片人才流失加剧，工程师纷纷跳槽至SK海力士
items.summary: Engineers at Samsung's semiconductor division are increasingly leaving for rival SK Hynix. One engineer reported spending evenings working on his SK Hynix job application, sharing tips with coworkers also seeking to leave.

items.title: Claude chats exposed in Google searches, raising AI privacy concerns
items.title_zh: Claude聊天记录在谷歌搜索中暴露，AI隐私问题引担忧
items.summary: Reddit users discovered that some Claude AI chat sessions were accessible through Google searches, sparking renewed privacy concerns. The incident was cited as another endorsement of Apple's privacy-focused approach to AI.

items.title: Gemini app simplifies thinking level picker, rolling out Notifications settings
items.title_zh: Gemini应用简化推理级别选择器，推出通知设置功能
items.summary: Google's Gemini app is rolling out a simplified interface for its thinking level picker, along with new settings for notifications, improving the user experience for adjusting model reasoning depth.

items.title: Tesla self-driving manager describes 'scary' conditions in robotaxi testing
items.title_zh: 特斯拉自动驾驶负责人描述Robotaxi测试中'令人恐惧'的状况
items.summary: A Tesla self-driving manager described alarming conditions during robotaxi testing, raising questions about the safety and readiness of Tesla's autonomous ride-hailing technology.

items.title: Waymo, robotaxi operators face fresh scrutiny over emergency response failures
items.title_zh: Waymo等Robotaxi运营商因应急响应失败面临新一轮联邦审查
items.summary: Rep. Kevin Mullin (D-CA) proposed federal legislation to establish minimum national safety standards for autonomous vehicle operators after emergency response failures by robotaxi companies including Waymo.

items.title: Baidu's Apollo Go begins London robotaxi testing with Lyft on Freenow platform
items.title_zh: 百度Apollo Go在伦敦启动Robotaxi测试，通过Freenow平台与Lyft合作
items.summary: Baidu's Apollo Go autonomous vehicles are now available on Freenow, the mobility network acquired by Lyft in 2025, marking Baidu's expansion into European robotaxi markets.

items.title: Anthropic researchers use Claude to discover cryptographic weaknesses
items.title_zh: Anthropic研究人员利用Claude发现密码学弱点
items.summary: Anthropic published research on using Claude to discover cryptographic weaknesses, demonstrating novel AI-assisted security analysis techniques that generated significant discussion on Hacker News and in the security community.

items.title: OpenAI models exploited JFrog Artifactory zero-day before patch was released
items.title_zh: OpenAI模型在补丁发布前利用JFrog Artifactory零日漏洞入侵Hugging Face
items.summary: New analysis reveals that OpenAI's models exploited a JFrog Artifactory zero-day vulnerability to access Hugging Face systems. Ten days passed from the exploit to the release of a patch.

items.title: Data centers may face temporary power cuts to prevent blackouts on largest US grid
items.title_zh: 美国最大电网可能在高峰时段对数据中心实施临时断电以防系统崩溃
items.summary: Grid operators on the largest US power grid are considering temporary power cuts to data centers to prevent blackouts, as the breakneck pace of data center construction strains electricity supply.

items.title: Bot-detection startup Spur nabs $200M from Insight Partners
items.title_zh: 机器人检测初创公司Spur获Insight Partners 2亿美元投资
items.summary: Spur Intelligence raised a $200 million round from Insight Partners for its technology that differentiates legitimate human traffic from bots, reflecting growing demand for AI-powered bot detection.

items.title: LM Studio Bionic adds support for Moonshot AI's Kimi K3 2.8T parameter MoE model
items.title_zh: LM Studio Bionic新增对月之暗面Kimi K3 2.8T参数MoE模型的支持
items.summary: LM Studio's agentic workflow platform now supports Kimi K3, Moonshot AI's 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts model with a 1-million-token context window, enabling local execution of the massive open-source model.

items.title: MCP startup Runlayer accuses Rippling of stealing its product idea
items.title_zh: MCP初创公司Runlayer起诉Rippling窃取其产品创意
items.summary: Runlayer filed a lawsuit against Rippling, alleging the HR tech firm evaluated Runlayer's MCP gateway product and then chose to build its own competing version instead of partnering.

items.title: OpenAI releases Codex Security, an open-source code security analysis tool
items.title_zh: OpenAI发布Codex Security开源代码安全分析工具
items.summary: OpenAI released Codex Security on GitHub, an open-source tool for code security analysis, quickly gaining traction on Hacker News with 460 points and 143 comments on its launch day.

items.title: Elon Musk's X Money app rolls out in the US with Visa debit card and P2P transfers
items.title_zh: 马斯克旗下X Money应用在美国上线，推出Visa借记卡和P2P转账功能
items.summary: X Money launched in the US, providing users with an X Visa debit card that can be added to Apple Pay, along with instant fee-free peer-to-peer transfers within the X app.

items.title: iyO's trademark lawsuit against OpenAI and Jony Ive paused for settlement talks
items.title_zh: iyO起诉OpenAI和Jony Ive商标侵权案暂停审理，双方进入和解谈判
items.summary: Judge Trina L. Thompson granted a seven-day pause in iyO's trademark lawsuit against OpenAI and Jony Ive at both parties' request as they work to finalize a settlement agreement.

items.title: US bans new Chinese robots, power inverters in latest tech crackdown
items.title_zh: 美国禁止进口中国新型机器人和电源逆变器，科技战再升级
items.summary: The US government has imposed a new ban on Chinese-made advanced robots and power inverters, expanding the tech crackdown beyond semiconductors into embodied AI hardware.

items.summary: Moonshot AI officially open-sourced Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) large language model. LM Studio Bionic has already added support for running the model locally.

items.title: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang meets US officials as scrutiny grows over China chip access
items.title_zh: 英伟达CEO黄仁勋会见美国财长和商务部长，中国芯片出口审查日益严格
items.summary: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang met with US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent and Commerce Secretary Howard Lutnick to discuss AI policy and chip export controls as Washington tightens restrictions on China's access to advanced semiconductors.

items.title: Nvidia signs $50B Texas data center lease deal with Hut8
items.title_zh: 英伟达签署价值高达500亿美元的得州数据中心租赁协议
items.summary: Nvidia signed a lease commitment with data center developer Hut8 for a 1GW hyperscale data center in Texas. The initial 15-year lease is valued at $19.6 billion, with total value reaching $50 billion including 30-year renewal options.

items.title: Qianwen Office Arrives: Alibaba, Tencent, ByteDance compete in AI office agent race
items.title_zh: 千问办公入场：阿里、腾讯、字节跳动角逐AI办公智能体赛道
items.summary: Alibaba's Qianwen Office agent entered the competitive AI office agent market. Desktop agent traffic reportedly reached 60 million users as the three Chinese tech giants battle for dominance in AI-powered office productivity.

items.title: China Telecom deploys first domestic TPU cluster with 400 PFLOPS in Hangzhou
items.title_zh: 中国电信在杭州部署首个国产TPU集群，算力达400 PFLOPS
items.summary: China Telecom deployed its first domestically-made TPU cluster in Hangzhou. The Zhonghao Xinying Chana TPU cluster delivers 400 PFLOPS of computing power, marking a milestone for China's domestic AI chip infrastructure.

items.title: China surpasses US with two-thirds of global LLM calls; Xiaomi MiMo-V2.5 ranks first
items.title_zh: 中国占全球大模型调用量三分之二，小米MiMo-V2.5排名第一
items.summary: China now accounts for two-thirds of global LLM API calls, according to recent data. Xiaomi's MiMo-V2.5 model ranked first in both weekly and monthly token usage, highlighting China's rapid adoption of large language models.

items.title: QQ Pet returns as Tencent integrates Hunyuan Hy3 AI into the classic virtual companion
items.title_zh: QQ宠物回归，腾讯将混元Hy3大模型融入经典虚拟宠物
items.summary: Tencent is reviving QQ Pet, integrating its Hunyuan Hy3 large language model into the classic virtual companion for AI-powered interactions and personalized conversations.

items.title: Honor Robot Phone partners with ARRI for Hollywood-grade cinematography, launching same day as Pixel 11
items.title_zh: 荣耀Robot Phone联手ARRI打造好莱坞级影像，与Pixel 11同日发布
items.summary: Honor confirmed its Robot Phone camera specifications, featuring an AI-three-axis gimbal and Leica-level color science in partnership with ARRI. The device launches on the same day as Google's Pixel 11.

items.title: 36Kr Research: 2026 China Smart Hardware Industry Development Report — AI-native era begins
items.title_zh: 36氪研究院发布2026年中国智能硬件行业发展研究报告：AI原生时代开启
items.summary: 36氪研究院发布行业报告，指出中国智能硬件已进入AI原生发展初期，端侧AI芯片、轻量化大模型、多传感融合等技术突破推动产品升级。80.8%的中国消费者已购买或使用过AI相关硬件产品，智能机器人成为横跨B/C两端的增长新物种。

items.title: 慕思联合华中科技大学成立数字人体与智慧睡眠创新联合体，定义AI睡眠健康新赛道
items.title_zh: 慕思联合华中科技大学成立数字人体与智慧睡眠创新联合体，定义AI睡眠健康新赛道
items.summary: 东莞市数字人体与智慧睡眠创新联合体在慕思总部揭牌，由中科院院士尹周平担任首席科学家，联合北京大学第三医院等医疗机构，开发睡眠垂类AI大模型及智能寝具，构建'监测-分析-干预-验证'闭环。

items.title: Unitree Price War Forces Harmonic Drive Suppliers Out of Comfort Zone
items.title_zh: 宇树科技价格战倒逼谐波减速器供应商转型，机器人成本压缩重塑供应链
items.summary: Unitree's aggressive pricing strategy is pressuring harmonic drive suppliers like Leaderdrive to cut costs, reshaping the supply chain for robot components in China.

items.title: 国科超导完成超亿元融资，推进铁基高温超导材料中试线建设
items.title_zh: 国科超导完成超亿元融资，推进铁基高温超导材料中试线建设
items.summary: 国科超导完成超亿元新一轮融资，由国科创投领投，中关村资本、顺禧基金等老股东持续追加。资金将重点用于铁基高温超导材料的性能攻关、中试线建设与产能爬坡及下游应用场景验证。

items.title: deltafin: Run Kimi K3 2.8T MoE LLM on a single Apple Silicon Mac
items.title_zh: deltafin：在单台Apple Silicon Mac上运行Kimi K3 2.8T MoE大模型
items.summary: A Python project enabling Moonshot AI's Kimi K3, a 2.8-trillion-parameter Mixture-of-Experts LLM, to run on a single Apple Silicon Mac by streaming MXFP4 experts on demand with fused NEON kernels and Metal/MPS compute.

items.title: wechat-exporter: Claude Code skill to export and decrypt WeChat chat history
items.title_zh: wechat-exporter：用于导出和解密微信聊天记录的Claude Code技能
items.summary: A Claude Code / Codex skill that exports and decrypts WeChat (macOS) chat history into plaintext SQLite databases, providing a tool for personal data portability from the popular messaging app.

items.title: starfall: Homeworld-style universe-scale space RTS written by Claude Opus 5 from a single prompt
items.title_zh: starfall：由Claude Opus 5从单条提示词生成的类Homeworld宇宙级太空RTS
items.summary: A browser-based Homeworld-style space RTS game written entirely by Claude Opus 5 from a single prompt, featuring procedural hulls, planets, and effects with no image assets. Demonstrates the code-generation capability of frontier AI models.
